name: Laravel 12 + Filament 3 + PostgreSQL
note: Each task runs a real command. No token figures are recorded here; evals/runner.py measures context cost directly from the kit files. The suite is Pest and runs against SQLite in-memory (DB_CONNECTION=sqlite, DB_DATABASE=:memory: in phpunit.xml) so no PostgreSQL service is required; the jsonb column maps to text on SQLite. AUTH-03, AUTH-04 and DATA-02 are asserted against Filament/Laravel behaviour and are not mutation-checkable from kit code. CI-01..03 (Gitleaks, Semgrep, composer audit) are pipeline gates not exercised by this suite.

eval_tasks.title: Application installs and boots
eval_tasks.instruction: Composer dependencies must resolve and the Laravel application must bootstrap far enough to list its routes.

eval_tasks.title: Feature behaviour
eval_tasks.instruction: The kit's feature tests must pass.
assertions: a user cannot view a customer owned by someone else
deleting a user cascades to their customers

eval_tasks.title: Declared security controls hold under test
eval_tasks.instruction: Run the suite that exercises the controls named in security/checks.json. Each test is mutation-verified where the control lives in kit code: removing the control makes the test fail.
assertions: AUTH-03 session id regenerates on login
AUTH-04 Filament login throttles after 5 attempts
AUTHZ-01 list and edit are scoped to the owner; created records are owned by the creator
AUTHZ-02 policy blocks other users for view, update and delete
DATA-01 table search treats injection as data
DATA-02 customer name is HTML-escaped in the table
UUID primary keys, empty APP_KEY, non-root Dockerfile

eval_tasks.title: Full suite green
eval_tasks.instruction: The complete suite must pass with no failures.
